Look of Kiln's in-game menus and windows: the game's, the game's see-through, Kiln's classic ember, or a theme a mod offers
With the look "theme": the theme (<mod id>:<name>; Kiln's in-game Look setting lists the ones your mods offer)
Window background opacity of the translucent look
Opacity of Kiln's whole in-game UI, text included
Size of Kiln's in-game UI on top of the display's scale
Language of Kiln's in-game texts: "auto" follows the game's text language, or a language tag such as "zh-CN" (the texts are Kiln's locales/<tag>.json; a language without a file shows English)
Chat history: Up and Down in the chat field bring back what you sent; your / commands are kept for next time
Kiln's frame cap: the game renders at most this many frames a second (0: off; 1 to 19 count as 20). Applies at once. With the game's own frame limit or V-Sync on too, the lowest limit decides

DLSS render preset while the game upscales with DLSS (not DLAA): default leaves it to the game and DLSS; J and K are DLSS 4's transformer models, L and M the newer ones of DLSS 4.5. Applies when the game next sets up DLSS (loading a world, or changing the DLSS mode or the resolution in the game's settings). The NVIDIA app's DLSS override wins over it. A DLSS setting turned on for the first time while the game runs applies from the next game start

DLSS render size: game (DLSS's own for the game's DLSS mode), perMode (the four scales below, one per DLSS mode) or custom (the render scale below for every mode). DLAA always renders at full size. Applies when the game next sets up DLSS. A DLSS setting turned on for the first time while the game runs applies from the next game start
With the DLSS render size custom: render width and height as a share of the output (0.67 = 67 %)
With the DLSS render size perMode: the render scale of DLSS Quality (the default is DLSS's own)
With the DLSS render size perMode: the render scale of DLSS Balanced (the default is DLSS's own)
With the DLSS render size perMode: the render scale of DLSS Performance (the default is DLSS's own)
With the DLSS render size perMode: the render scale of DLSS Ultra Performance (the default is DLSS's own)
A small readout in a corner of the game: rendered and output frames a second, frame time, the upscaler, its mode, render and output size, and the DLSS preset
